sentences.en: The qualitative improvement in customer service has been noticeable.
sentences.zh: 客户服务的质量有了明显的提升。

sentences.en: We need to focus on the qualitative aspects, not just the quantitative data.
sentences.zh: 我们需要关注质量方面的因素，而不仅仅是量化数据。

sentences.en: The qualitative analysis of the soil showed it was very fertile.
sentences.zh: 对土壤进行定性分析后发现它非常肥沃。

senses.zh: 定性的，定质的,性质上的,质量的
